title: UI风格#54 - Constructivist (建构主义)
description: 创建第54种UI风格：建构主义风格 - 俄國构成主义、几何纸张、红黑力量。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planBB.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Constructivist style When color palette Then features bold red, black, white, yellow geometric
Given Constructivist style When typography Then uses revolutionary fonts: Oswald, Bebas Neue, or Roboto Condensed
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Oswald (headers 4rem bold uppercase), Roboto Condensed (body 0.95rem)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Constructivist style When layout Then geometric shapes, diagonal lines, propaganda poster style
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: 4 geometric shapes (red triangle, yellow trapezoid, blue diamond, black parallelogram), diagonal divider (clip-path), red offset box on chat

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Constructivist style When UI elements Then bold shapes, revolutionary banners, geometric dividers
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: thick 3-4px black borders, bold uppercase text, hover color inversion, diagonal clip-path divider

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Constructivist UI When functional Then includes poster chat, worker agents, production stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: assembly line chat, 4 worker cards (Stakhanov/Rodchenko/Krupskaya/Tukhachevsky) with Output/Efficiency/Blueprints/Vision/Sprints/Unity/Tests/Quality stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Constructivist UI When copy Then uses revolutionary slogans: 'Construct', 'Produce', 'Unite', 'Progress'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'CONSTRUCT. PRODUCE. UNITE.', tagline 'The future is built by those who act', button 'BUILD', greeting 'Productivity is the path to progress', status 'Building'/'Idle', nav 'Factory'/'Command'
